claims.claim_text: ALGO is framed as a multi-year, low-velocity quantum-safe infrastructure and RWA/institutional settlement narrative, not a near-term trading catalyst.
Structural weaknesses cited: no burn mechanism, no revenue redistribution, inflationary staking, and developer ecosystem funding roughly 100x smaller than Solana comparable pool.
Provided PRO text claims SEC/digital commodity treatment removes some legal uncertainty, but this claim must be verified before codifying as factual.

claims.claim_text: AERO is framed as a structural Base DeFi liquidity hub candidate with potential repricing from multi-chain EVM expansion.

PRO text cites approximately 51% supply locked, average lock duration 3.7 years, 93% of large holders at maximum lock, nearly $500M protocol fees distributed, no VC overhang, no team unlock pressure, and no inflationary emission gimmick.
Core risk is whether Aerodrome can replicate Base dominance across additional EVM-compatible chains; downside risk is concentrated in Base ecosystem dependency and competitive displacement.

claims.claim_text: ENJ is framed as a speculative sector-bounded lottery ticket on gaming/NFT adoption, not structural capital allocation.

PRO text cites no clear fundamental catalyst for the rally, daily active users down roughly 70% from peak, 2021 buyer overhead supply, and gaming/NFT vertical not meaningfully recovered from 2021 contraction.
A sustained move above 0.31 on volume would support watching for continuation; failure to clear 0.31 suggests distribution or legacy-holder exit risk.
